jobs.title: Client Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

True Price Auto is looking for a personable, organized, and automotive\-minded **Client Onboarding Specialist** to become the first point of contact for our new clients.

True Price is an automotive advocacy company that helps consumers navigate the car\-buying process. Rather than representing a dealership, our team works on behalf of the buyer to help them identify the right vehicle, shop dealerships, negotiate pricing, arrange financing, and make the overall buying experience easier.

The Client Onboarding Specialist plays an important role at the very beginning of that process.

**What You'll Do**

When a new client signs up with True Price, you'll be one of the first people they interact with. Your job is to understand exactly what they're looking for, help narrow down their vehicle options, and prepare the client for a smooth handoff to one of our Auto Advocates.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Reaching out to new clients promptly after they sign up with True Price
* Reviewing each client's vehicle preferences, budget, priorities, and must\-have features
* Speaking directly with clients to clarify their needs and answer initial questions
* Researching makes, models, trims, features, and available vehicle options
* Helping clients who aren't sure what they want narrow their search
* Creating a personalized shortlist of vehicles that fit each client's needs
* Identifying potential alternatives when another vehicle may be a better fit
* Documenting important client information and vehicle preferences in our CRM
* Preparing a clear, organized handoff for the Auto Advocate assigned to the client
* Communicating with Auto Advocates to make sure they have everything needed to begin shopping
* Maintaining a positive, responsive experience during the client's first interaction with True Price

**What We're Looking For**

You don't need to be a car salesperson. In fact, this isn't a sales position.

We're looking for someone who is naturally good at **listening, researching, communicating, and solving problems.**

The right person will be:

* Friendly and confident communicating with clients by phone and text
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple clients at once
* Detail\-oriented and able to accurately document client needs
* Comfortable researching vehicles online
* Able to understand the differences between vehicle models, trims, features, and price points
* Curious and willing to learn about the automotive industry
* Comfortable working with CRM and other web\-based software
* Able to work independently while collaborating closely with the rest of the True Price team
* Focused on providing an exceptional client experience

Automotive knowledge is a major plus, but extensive dealership experience is not required.

* Able to work independently while collaborating closely with the rest of the True Price team
* Focused on providing an exceptional client experience

Automotive knowledge is a major plus, but extensive dealership experience is not required.

**Why This Position Matters**

Buying a vehicle can get complicated quickly.

Some clients come to us knowing the exact year, make, model, trim, and color they want. Others simply know they need "a reliable three\-row SUV under $40,000\."

You'll help turn those conversations into a clear plan.

By the time a client reaches their Auto Advocate, the Advocate should understand **who the client is, what they're looking for, what matters most to them, and which vehicles make the most sense to pursue.**

That preparation allows our Advocates to spend more time doing what they do best: finding the right vehicle, negotiating the deal, and helping the client complete their purchase.

True Price Auto was built around a simple idea: **the person buying the vehicle should have someone in their corner.**

Our Auto Advocates work for the client, not the dealership. We help consumers research vehicles, compare options, negotiate deals, navigate financing, and make smarter decisions throughout the buying process.

**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Wealth National Client Onboarding Specialist is a subject matter expert on investment procedures and processes and will work on a team focused on delivering all aspects of client onboarding and operational solutions for clients and prospective clients of Senior Wealth Advisors (SWA) of Citi Personal Wealth Management. They will provide on\-site (and sometimes remote) support for SWAs serving as their primary point\-of\-contact with internal partners and clients, as they manage end\-to\-end client onboarding to ensure client relationship transition is handled efficiently and seamlessly with VIP care. The Wealth National Client Onboarding Specialist works closely with business partners and will travel to the SWA’s branch location.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Exhibits exceptional relationship building qualities and acts as the primary point of contact for client onboarding working with clients, SWAs, wealth teams, and leadership.
* Efficiently addresses inquiries from the SWA and the wealth team and connects them with business partners to support their requests.
* Liaises with strategic partners, managers, and departments to effect client requests promptly and achieve excellent internal and external customer service.
* Recommends improvements for investment procedural and process related activities throughout the client onboarding lifecycle.
* Documents, tracks, and monitors client onboarding and items escalated to them to ensure a timely resolution using internal tracking system.
* Fulfills client onboarding functions such as, documenting client responses to customer profile data attributes from the client agreement, account opening initiation, including complex and cross\-border accounts, asset transfer, account maintenance and other activities requiring FINRA General Securities Representative licensure.
* Keeps detailed records of open client onboarding issues and monitors them accordingly.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Travel required up to 70% of time to various branches and office locations, primarily within the assigned region, but could include other locations as needed.

**Qualifications:**


* 5\-8 years of relevant experience

* Ability to manage and expedite multiple tasks in a dynamic, fast paced service environment.

**About our Company**:


Medidata is powering smarter treatments and healthier people through digital solutions to support clinical trials. Celebrating over 25 years of ground\-breaking technological innovation across more than 38,000 trials and 12 million patients, Medidata offers industry\-leading expertise, analytics\-powered insights, and one of the largest clinical trial data sets in the industry. More than 1 million registered users across approximately 2,300 customers trust Medidata's seamless, end\-to\-end platform to improve patient experiences, accelerate clinical breakthroughs, and bring therapies to market faster. A Dassault Systèmes brand (Euronext Paris: FR0014003TT8, DSY.PA), Medidata is headquartered in New York City and has been recognized as a Leader by Everest Group and IDC. The **Senior Implementation Consultant – Enablement** serves as a vital bridge between Medidata’s Patient Experience technology and the clients and teams who rely on it. By designing and delivering high\-impact enablement strategies, best\-practice training, and strategic consultation, this role empowers Implementation Consultants and external clients to seamlessly adopt, build, and optimize our eCOA and Patient Experience solutions—ultimately accelerating clinical trials and bringing life\-saving therapies to market faster.

jobs.title: EMR Consultant
jobs.description:
**JOB OVERVIEW:**

The EMR Consultant is responsible for day\-to\-day operational management, and new projects \+ enhancement requests of our EMR platform and its connected clinical and financial ecosystem. This role serves as a trusted partner to clinic providers, physicians, operational leaders, revenue cycle teams, and third\-party vendors.

The ideal candidate should have the following skills:

* A hands\-on performer who is comfortable moving between detailed issue resolution, project coordination, vendor management, and stakeholder leadership.
* A relationship builder who earns credibility with physicians, providers, clinic teams, Revenue Cycle partners, and technical teams.
* A clear communicator who sets expectations, shares both good and difficult news transparently, and follows through on commitments.
* A collaborative professional who balances urgency, quality, accountability, cost\-effectiveness, and user experience.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**1\. EMR Operations, Provider Partnership \& Support**

* Serve as the primary operational owner of the EMR platform and its connected workflows, interfaces, and vendor relationships.
* Act as the primary liaison among providers, clinic staff, operational leaders, technical teams, Revenue Cycle, and ancillary partners.
* Manage day\-to\-day EMR incidents, service requests, user support needs, configuration questions, and operational follow\-up.
* Assess, prioritize, coordinate, and communicate the resolution of EMR\-related issues based on patient care, provider workflow, financial, compliance, and business impact.
* Work directly with EMR and third\-party vendors to troubleshoot issues, coordinate escalations, confirm resolution, and keep stakeholders informed.
* Monitor macro view of issues and activities and identify and recommend sustainable corrective actions and improvements.
* Work with Provider Super Users and Trainers to promote EMR best practices and educate users on features, tools, and workflows that improve productivity and clinical effectiveness.
* Develop and maintain operating procedures, support documentation, issue logs, decision records, and user guidance.
* Ensure agreed service levels, support commitments, action items, and vendor obligations are tracked and met.

**2\. EMR Enhancement Requests, Upgrades and Projects**

* · Lead new enhancement requests and EMR\-related projects from initial concept through implementation and post\-production support.
* · Coordinate requests through all phases of Healix's project lifecycle methodology, including intake, assessment, prioritization, requirements, solution design, planning, build or configuration, testing, training, deployment, validation, and closeout.
* · Partner with stakeholders to define business needs, expected outcomes, requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and implementation readiness.
* · Develop and maintain project plans, status updates, decisions, action items, and stakeholder communications.
* · Coordinate internal team members and third\-party vendor personnel to deliver agreed outcomes.
* · Facilitate project meetings, testing sessions, workflow reviews, implementation planning, and post\-implementation evaluations.
* · Support system upgrades, integrations, interfaces, regulatory changes, and other initiatives affecting the EMR environment.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience supporting, administering, implementing an ambulatory, specialty, post\-acute, or long\-term care EMR.
* Hands\-on experience assessing issues, coordinating resolution, managing priorities, and working directly with software vendors.
* Experience coordinating enhancements or projects across multiple phases of a structured project lifecycle methodology.
* Ability to lead cross\-functional internal teams and external vendor resources without relying solely on formal authority.
* Understanding of clinical, provider, ambulatory practice, or healthcare operational workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including meeting facilitation, documentation, and stakeholder updates.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, follow\-through, and problem\-solving skills.
* Positive attitude, high level of ownership, sound judgment, and a service\-oriented approach.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment and collaborate with both on\-site and remote team members.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience supporting revenue cycle workflows, including documentation, charge capture, coding, claims, and reimbursement activities.
* Experience coordinating laboratory, diagnostic, HIE, e\-prescribing, or other clinical system integrations.
* Knowledge of healthcare interoperability concepts and standards such as HL7, FHIR, CCD, and C\-CDA.
* Project management, process improvement, or related training or certification.

**HEALIX CORE VALUES:**

The EMR Consultant must live and demonstrate the Healix Core Values in daily decisions, relationships, and results:

**CORE VALUE \- WHAT IT MEANS AT HEALIX**

**Client Centric \-** We succeed when we help our clients succeed in serving their patients and members.

**Collaboration \-** We go out of our way to listen, help, and communicate with each other and our clients.

**Trust \-** We build trust with our clients and within our teams through every action and decision. We remain accountable, communicate transparently, and learn from mistakes.

**Innovation \-** We continuously learn and embrace technology and processes that provide real business value and secure solutions for Healix and its clients.

**Cost\-Effective \-** We maximize our assets, remain accountable for expenses, include others to improve efficiency and problem\-solving, and manage third parties to meet Healix expectations and Core Values.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* Hybrid work arrangement combining in\-office and remote work based on business, provider, and project needs.
* Must live within reasonable commuting distance of the designated Healix office.
* Occasional travel may be required for clinic, vendor, implementation, or project activities.
* After\-hour availability may be required for planned implementations, upgrades, or critical production events.

*Healix is committed to building a professional, collaborative workplace. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.*

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have knowledge of healthcare interoperability concepts and standards such as HL7, FHIR, CCD and C\-CDA?
* Do you have experience supporting revenue cycle workflows, including documentation, charge capture, coding, claims, and reimbursement activities?
* Do you have experience coordinating laboratory, diagnostic, HIE, e\-prescribing or other clinical system integrations?
* Do you have experience with project management, process improvement or related training or certification?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Little Rock, AR 72201

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist**
=============================

**About the Role**
------------------


Prospyr is looking for an **Implementation Specialist** to help new customers successfully transition onto Prospyr and get their teams operational as quickly and confidently as possible.


You’ll own the implementation process from post\-sale handoff through go\-live, coordinating configuration, data migration, workflows, training, and launch readiness.


This role is highly project\-oriented. You'll manage multiple implementations simultaneously while working closely with customers and internal teams to keep projects organized, remove blockers, and ensure customers are prepared to operate successfully in Prospyr.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Implementation Project Management**

* Own customer implementations from Sales handoff through successful go\-live.
* Build and manage implementation plans, milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.
* Coordinate customer and internal stakeholders throughout the project.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers early and drive them toward resolution.
* Maintain clear communication around project status and next steps.

### **Platform Configuration**

* Guide customers through configuration of their Prospyr environment.
* Help customers translate existing operational workflows into Prospyr.
* Coordinate setup across areas such as:


	+ Providers and staff
	+ Locations
	+ Scheduling
	+ Services and catalog
	+ Forms and consents
	+ Payments
	+ Patient communications
	+ Inventory
	+ Memberships
	+ Online booking
	+ Integrations and other applicable features
* Validate configuration prior to go\-live.

### **Data Migration \& Integrations**

* Coordinate data migration requirements between customers and internal technical teams.
* Help customers understand what data is required and how it should be prepared.
* Track migration progress and validate readiness with the customer.
* Coordinate third\-party integrations and dependencies when applicable.
* Escalate technical blockers with clear documentation and business impact.

### **Training \& Go\-Live Readiness**

* Coordinate and deliver role\-based customer training.
* Ensure administrators, providers, front\-desk teams, and other users understand the workflows relevant to their roles.
* Develop a clear go\-live readiness checklist for each implementation.
* Identify knowledge gaps before launch and coordinate additional training where needed.
* Provide additional support during the transition into live operations.

### **Process Improvement**

* Identify recurring implementation friction and opportunities to improve Prospyr's onboarding process.
* Help develop implementation templates, playbooks, checklists, documentation, and training resources.
* Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring implementation blockers.
* Help move repeatable onboarding activities toward scalable self\-service experiences.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Customers launch on time with minimal disruption to their businesses.
* Implementation timelines and responsibilities are clear to customers and internal teams.
* Data migration and configuration issues are identified before go\-live.
* Customers enter ongoing CX management with strong platform knowledge and clearly defined workflows.
* Time\-to\-value and time\-to\-go\-live improve as implementation processes become more standardized.
* Fewer post\-launch support issues originate from incomplete configuration or training.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 2–4\+ years of SaaS implementation, onboarding, project management, or customer success experience.
* Strong project\-management and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously.
* Comfortable learning complex software and becoming highly proficient in product configuration.
* Strong customer communication and training skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot problems and coordinate effectively with technical teams.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where processes continue to evolve.
* Healthcare, EMR, medical aesthetics, wellness, payments, or vertical SaaS experience is a plus.

**Role Philosophy**
-------------------


Implementation owns the question:

**“What needs to happen to get this customer successfully live on Prospyr?”**


The Implementation Specialist drives that process from beginning to end, while creating a clean transition to the CXM who will own the customer's long\-term success.

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Medical Billing and EHR Instructor**

**Location: LaGuardia Community College**

**Department: Adult and Continuing Education (ACE) \- Career and Professional Program**

**Status: Part\-Time**

**Salary: $55 \- $60/hr.**

**Schedule: November 30, 2026 – February 8, 2027**

**Modality: Hybrid**

**Program Description**

The Healthcare Finance and Operations Training Program (formerly known as Medical Billing Specialist Program) is designed to prepare students with little or no healthcare experience to obtain entry level positions at revenue cycle, finance, and operations within the healthcare industry.

The program delivers 315 hours of intensive training over six months through six comprehensive modules that include Introduction to the US Healthcare System, Medical Billing \& EHR Training, Business Communication \& Customer Service, virtual operations, Introduction to Healthcare Data Analytics, Healthcare Accounting and Revenue Cycle Management, and Career and Job Readiness.

Initiated in 2013, in response to the hiring needs of New York area medical institutions, the training curriculum is regularly updated to align with current workforce needs. Recent enhancements have strengthened participants’ critical thinking, data analysis, and AI literacy skills that are increasingly essential in today's healthcare environment.

The topics covered in the Medical Billing and EHR module include:

· Electronic Health Records and Medical Documentation

· Health insurance, managed care, and revenue cycle management

· Legal and regulatory issues and Introduction to medical terminology

· The heart of medical billing \-CMS 1500, UB 04 form, ICD 10 coding, CPT coding, HCPCS, CMS Reimbursement methodologies, Medicare and Medicaid, TRICARE, EOB and payments

· Electronic Health Records simulation training

**Position Overview**

The Healthcare Finance and Operations Program is seeking an experienced Part\-Time Medical Billing and Electronic Health Record Instructor to prepare students for careers in medical billing or revenue cycle operations.

The instructor will deliver practical, career focused instructions covering insurance claims processes and forms, the proper methods of completing a CMS 1500 and UB 04 form, and the understanding ICD\-10\-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding.

This position is well suited for professionals with hands\-on medical billing or revenue cycle experience with strong communication and teaching skills. The candidate should have in\-depth knowledge in medical billing, medical terminologies, and revenue cycle, and can translate industry practices into engaging classroom learning. Candidate should have familiarity with EPIC and EPIC\-look alike simulative software.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Revision, Update, and Development of Course Materials
* Review and update syllabus, lesson plans, study materials per the program requirements
* Create exercises, quizzes, assignments, and other instructional materials
* Ensure learning outcomes are delivered as defined by the course syllabus and program expectations.

**Technical Instructions**

Prepare students to:

* distinguish between the major classes of health insurance contracts,
* understand the insurance verification process,
* analyze the insurance cards of patients,
* describe the differences between rejected and denied claims,
* understand and identify the CPT and ICD codes,
* accurately fill the CMS 1500 and CMS 1450/UB 04 form needed for medical billing

Demonstrate appropriate use of EHR software and electronic documentation workflow

Promote critical thinking and problem\-solving skills through the lessons

Student Support and Administrative Responsibilities

· Maintain attendance and grade records

· Assess students’ performance, maintain documentation of student progress, and provide feedback as appropriate

· Hold office hours to provide additional student guidance and support

· Participate in instructor meetings, as needed

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* At least 5 years of experience in healthcare management
* Bachelor’s Degree in Healthcare or Finance
* Expert understanding of medical billing, medical terminology, and electronic health record
* Ability to create and modify curriculum
* Experience preparing and delivering lesson plans, training sessions, or other structured instructional content
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey technical information in a clear and concise manner.
* Ability to serve the needs of traditional and non\-traditional students.

**Preferred Qualifications**
